entities.summary: Dr. Helmut Pfleger is a German chess grandmaster and author. He was one of the most promising chess players in the 1960s and 1970s. By profession, he is a doctor of medicine. Helmut Pfleger was a journalists & chroniclers from Teplice (b. 1943-08-06, Teplice). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
